description: WPF application to interface with FarDriver motor controllers over Bluetooth LE

tasks.title: Create PRD.json
tasks.description: Create a PRD.json tracking document mapping out all backlog tasks, their acceptance criteria, and completion flags.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: PRD.json exists and is formatted correctly.

tasks.title: Create CloseDriver.Core
tasks.description: Create a .NET 8 Class Library named CloseDriver.Core and install CommunityToolkit.Mvvm, DI, and Logging packages.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Project compiles successfully.

tasks.title: Create CloseDriver.Wpf
tasks.description: Create an empty WPF .NET 8 project named CloseDriver.Wpf that references CloseDriver.Core and configures the DI ServiceProvider.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Project compiles, runs, and displays an empty window.

tasks.title: Create CloseDriver.Tests
tasks.description: Create a companion xUnit test project CloseDriver.Tests and reference CloseDriver.Core.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: dotnet test runs and passes a dummy test.

tasks.title: Initialize Git Repository
tasks.description: Initialize a Git repository using 'git flow' structure (with release as the main trunk and develop for check-ins), add a standard .NET/WPF .gitignore, commit the initial structure, and push to a new GitHub repository named CloseDriver.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: git branch shows develop and release, and git remote -v shows the GitHub origin.

tasks.title: Create GitHub Actions Workflow
tasks.description: Create a basic GitHub Actions workflow (.github/workflows/dotnet.yml) to automatically build the project and run xUnit tests on push to develop and release.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: The workflow triggers on the next push and passes.

tasks.title: Define IBluetoothService and Mock
tasks.description: Define an IBluetoothService interface and create a mocked implementation for testing.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Interface and mock compile successfully.

tasks.title: Create MainViewModel and Scan Button
tasks.description: Create MainViewModel with a 'Scan For Devices' command, and update MainWindow.xaml with a Top-Left docked button.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Unit test confirms the command triggers the scanning logic on the mock service.

tasks.title: Implement WindowsBluetoothService
tasks.description: Implement WindowsBluetoothService using Windows.Devices.Bluetooth to actually scan for BLE devices.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Manual test: run the app, click scan, verify devices are found in the debug console.

tasks.title: Create DeviceDialog
tasks.description: Create a modal DeviceDialog (View and ViewModel) containing a vertical list of devices. Link it to the Scan button.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Manual test: dialog opens, scan initiates, list populates.

tasks.title: Add Select Device Button
tasks.description: Add a 'Select Device' button to the dialog, enabled only when a list item is selected. Clicking it tracks the device and closes the dialog.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Unit test confirms SelectedDevice updates correctly; Manual test confirms button behavior and dialog closure.

tasks.title: Connect and Subscribe to Notifications
tasks.description: Extend IBluetoothService to connect to the selected device and subscribe to characteristic notifications (read stream).
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Unit test with mocked data stream.

tasks.title: Create DataLogger
tasks.description: Create a DataLogger class that formats incoming byte arrays and writes them to a file with timestamps.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Unit test asserts the output file contents match the expected hex formatting.

tasks.title: Add Log To File Toggle
tasks.description: Add a 'Log To File' toggle button to MainWindow.xaml (docked Top-Right), enabled only when a device is selected.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Unit test confirms command toggles state and initiates/stops the logger.

tasks.title: Live Test Logging
tasks.description: Perform a live test with a FarDriver controller to log incoming data to a file.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Manual check of the generated log file for valid hex traffic.

tasks.title: Port FardriverData C++ struct
tasks.description: Port the 512-byte FardriverData C++ struct and bitfields from the C++ FarDriver repo into a C# FarDriverProtocolParser using StructLayout and bit-shifting.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Create automated unit tests that feed the raw hex data (from Phase 3) into the parser to ensure it correctly identifies frames and decodes the exact values.

tasks.title: Map Payload Bytes to Settings
tasks.description: Map the parsed payload bytes to specific controller settings (e.g., voltage, limits, temperatures).
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Unit tests asserting specific byte arrays yield the correct integer/float setting values based on the C++ math.

tasks.title: Implement Polling/Handshake
tasks.description: Implement any necessary polling/handshake requests if the controller requires a prompt to send settings.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Unit tests asserting the correct request byte sequences are generated.

tasks.title: Create SettingsViewModel
tasks.description: Create a SettingsViewModel that exposes the decoded settings as bindable properties.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Unit tests confirming that when the parser decodes a new frame, the ViewModel properties update (via INotifyPropertyChanged).

tasks.title: Design Settings UI
tasks.description: Design and implement the UI (XAML) to display the settings in a structured way (e.g., tabs, grouped panels).
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Manual UI verification with mocked data.

tasks.title: Investigate Authentication
tasks.description: Investigate FarDriver authentication/binding.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Unit tests that replicate the phone's authentication byte sequence.

tasks.title: Implement Encoding Logic
tasks.description: Implement encoding logic in FarDriverProtocolParser to convert setting changes back into byte frames.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Unit tests asserting that changing a setting yields the expected hex byte frame.

tasks.title: Add Edit Settings UI
tasks.description: Add UI controls (textboxes, comboboxes) to edit settings, and a 'Save/Write' button to transmit them.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Unit tests confirming the save action encodes the data and calls the Bluetooth write service. Manual test on a real controller.
